notes.title: Elise – Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’ve just released a new patch for Elise focused on bug fixes, performance improvements, and a better overall gameplay experience. Here’s what’s new:

Bug Fixes
Fixed a wide range of bugs and glitches reported by the community.

Improved Optimization
Smoother performance and reduced loading times across the board.

Hospital Level Improvements
Added more inventory items to discover and use.
Increased resource availability for better progression.

More Save Rooms + Coins
Added additional save rooms and more coins, giving you more chances to save your progress.

Audio Fixes
Corrected audio issues in some areas.

Thank you all for your continued support, feedback, and reviews. Keep them coming – they help us make Elise even better. More updates are on the way!

— Stuart

notes.title: Update notes 31/12/2024
notes.content:
Added the ability to skip puzzles after 5 minutes (however doing so you will not get the achievement for that puzzle) 
improved lighting in some areas 
improved the light on the shotgun 
added a light behind the player so they are always visible in dark areas 
the door to the security room has been removed and is now accessible the key item inside has been moved somewhere else 
add a brightness slider in the game menu (this will be moved to another menu later on)
